meta.title: TARGET DESIGN — Admission, fence, restore and revocation (not implemented)

cards.title: Admission and source of truth
items: Prepare starts nothing. Actual frame encoding/size and queue checks precede possible-send; a failure remains definitely unsent. Duplicate confirmation observes the original operation.

Delegate creation compares active origin generation before any ordinary task-directory/prepared fragment, under maintenance SHARED + the per-ID namespace lease through durable commit. Refusal is checked before fragments.
A lost ACK enters the uncertainty row. No blind resend or new identity. Passive resolve cannot launch; explicit dispatch-authorized recovery may complete only the existing frozen prepared request.

cards.title: Fence is not synthetic absence
items: Absent fence and create share one permanent per-ID namespace authority. Existing task returns existing; contention or uncertain evidence returns pending/unresolved. A late create must honor refusal.

Partial entries need full canonical no-launch proof under established admission/lifetime/run exclusion before the final nonblocking namespace check. Never call external recovery while holding namespace.
Unknown-origin fragments require explicit local operator selection/proof; never automatic MCP scan. Refusal proves no ordinary task admission/launch, not completed helper cleanup or zero cost.

cards.title: Restore barrier before inventory and reopen
items: Supported restore invalidates old certificates/tokens, clears effective restored grants/cloud authority and blocks admissions. Complete operator device/root roster includes destinations added after the snapshot.

Apply a fresh disabled admission generation durably on every destination before inventory. Old preparations cannot commit after the barrier. Missing roster/device/barrier/completeness keeps restore blocked.
Inventory covers immutable origin membership, refusals and partial entries. Reconstruct from canonical origin receipts or drain/cancel via Delegate; ownerless operations stay operator-only.

Reopen is local admin only, with regular re-enrolled credentials and explicit grant reapproval after all-destination reconciliation. Delegate revalidates membership/completeness under maintenance EXCLUSIVE immediately before enabling; changed membership requires refreshed inventory. No force-release shortcut.

cards.title: Revocation and quota limits
items: Gateway rechecks rights before sends/responses and on cached views/chunks. Revocation closes sockets and removes unsent queued messages; already-transmitted work may finish.

Revocation, timeout, TTL or disconnect never proves task termination. Retain reservations through unknown; release only authoritative terminal/refused or proven never-sent expiry. Defaults: 2 per device, 32 global.
Recovery-only re-enrollment of the same device may permit observation/cancel/fence but never admission/resume/reopen. Unreachable retained evidence keeps accounting blocked.

All routed task controls may verify whole payloads: one scan/device, three ordinary scans fleet-wide plus one protected cancel/fence scan. Busy cancellation returns resource_limit without queuing or preemption. Routing permits remain held through actual CLI Wait/cleanup, independently of Delegate execution reservations.

cards.title: Scope and review gate
items: Source: approved implementation contract v7, MCP / OPERATION CONTRACT; DELEGATE PUBLIC PREREQUISITE; RECOVERY OPERATIONS CLARIFICATIONS; FINAL INVARIANT CLARIFICATION.
Separate rows are related safety procedures, not automatic transitions. Request success is not task success; cancel acknowledgment is not confirmed closure. Planned controls are not implemented here.
Before PR: no known unresolved P0/P1/P2, independent reviews, and required checks. Separate Delegate work uses its dedicated worktree and own harness.
